name: Assisted Chin-Up
steps: Select the counterweight on an assisted pull-up machine, take a shoulder-width underhand grip, and kneel carefully on the assistance pad.
Hang with straight arms, draw your shoulder blades slightly down, and brace your core.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs to lift your chest smoothly until your chin clears the handles.
Lower yourself slowly back to straight arms without letting the assistance pad slam down.
tips: Keep your chin level rather than craning your neck upward to clear the handles.
Control the descent all the way to full extension so the counterweight stays smooth.
